assumptions.risk_if_false: Spatial subgroup or access differences may be hidden
assumptions.statement: The resource system is represented by one aggregate stock variable

assumptions.risk_if_false: Operating rules or infrastructure changes may alter usable capacity
assumptions.sensitivity_test: Compare lower and higher capacity scenarios
assumptions.statement: Capacity is fixed within each scenario

assumptions.sensitivity_test: Add low baseline and high inflow scenarios
assumptions.statement: Inflow is represented as a scenario value rather than a random process

assumptions.risk_if_false: Losses may depend on temperature leakage season or surface area
assumptions.statement: Losses are proportional to current stock

assumptions.risk_if_false: Severity duration and affected users may be hidden
assumptions.sensitivity_test: Compare shortage frequency severity and duration metrics
assumptions.statement: Shortage periods are used as a risk metric
